optimizedContext.value:
# ChangeRepository Port

## Rules
- Extends `Repository`; inherited workspace accessors present but unused (global storage).
- `get(name)` active `changes/` only → `Change|null`; may auto-invalidate+persist drift under lock; not RMW primitive — use `mutate`. Missing state defaults `missing`.
- `getDraft`/`getDiscarded` bucket-only → views; no auto-invalidate.
- `mutate(name,fn)`: exclusive per-name lock; reload fresh (skip nested write/auto-invalidate); `fn` on non-drafted; persist on success; throw `ChangeNotFoundError` if missing/draft-only. Different names MAY concurrent.
- `mutateDraft`: same for drafts; only RestoreChange/DiscardChange (+ internals) in prod; may move dirs.
- Auto-invalidate on get when validatedHash mismatches cleaned hash (if artifact types resolved): lock → reload → collect ALL drifted keys → drifted-pending-review → invalidate designing → persist. Cause `artifact-drift`; actor `SYSTEM_ACTOR`. Lifecycle-independent.
- `list` → `ActiveChangeListEntry` sort createdAt asc; `listDrafts` draftedAt desc; `listDiscarded` discardedAt desc. include* projection only. No full aggregates/history/content.
- `count`/`countDrafts`/`countDiscarded` = list totals from index. `reindex`/`reindexActive`/`reindexDrafts`/`reindexDiscarded` rebuild `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/`.
- `save` manifest only (atomic); drafted → `DraftedChangeReadOnlyError` outside mutateDraft. `delete` removes dir.
- `artifact` loads tracked files + `originalHash` sha256; `saveArtifact` conflict check / `force`; drafted blocked; after write reset status in-progress (caller save). `artifactExists`/`deltaExists` presence only.
- `changePath` active under changes/; `draftChangePath` under drafts/. `internalPaths()`: abs paths or undefined (not empty array for N/A); Fs includes changes/drafts/discarded.
- `scaffold`/`unscaffold` for specs/deltas dirs (idempotent unscaffold).
- Abstract class; all storage ops abstract. Artifact API confined to tracked files + change dir.

## Constraints
- Global not per-workspace.
- get may auto-invalidate under lock when drift + (beyond designing OR active approvals) per Fs impl.
- list* lightweight; get* for detail.
- No default list limit (full bucket when omitted).
- save vs saveArtifact separated; ArtifactConflictError sole concurrency error; force bypasses; originalHash=sha256; atomic manifest writes.
